articles.title: Is Kajima (TSE:1812) Priced Right For Its Earnings Power?
articles.summary: Kajima has delivered very strong share price gains over the past few years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are paying for its earnings today. With the stock now well above where it traded five years ago, the key issue is whether the current valuation is still grounded in the company’s profit power. The share price has risen 283.0% over 5 years. As a result, anyone looking at Kajima now is effectively being asked to pay a very different earnings multiple than long term holders...
